operator_definition: The current physical robot pose is the working zero pose for K0-K4.
encoder_assumption_confirmed_by_operator: All five motors use absolute encoders.
capture_method: Existing project software zero path: POST /api/command/set_zero -> read each motor 0x92 -> atomically save axis-offsets-native.txt -> load as fixed absolute encoder coordinate offsets.
operational_rule: This is the authoritative working zero. Future deployments must preserve axis-offsets-native.txt. Do not use the superseded 2026-07-24 offsets.
return_to_zero_meaning: Commanding K0-K4 logical zero returns the motors to the absolute encoder coordinates captured in this record, subject to normal transmission integrity.
